create_TopkSaver: create a TopkSaver instance with a save directory and top-k value to track best models
save_model_with_performance: save a model and state dict with its performance score using TopkSaver save method
save_latest_model: save the latest model checkpoint using TopkSaver with save_latest flag set to True
save_model_with_force_name: save a model with a custom filename using TopkSaver force_save_name parameter
review_TopkSaver_class: review the TopkSaver class that maintains top-k best performing models by performance score
